_comment: Phase E: full 18-pair training search (plan.md §9, §10). The paper's tree is roots=3, branching=3, width=8, depth=5, with no early stopping, candidates all valid and no dedup giving 9+24+24+24+24=105 candidates and 1890 candidate-task evaluations at repeats=1. The paper additionally uses 4 optimization seeds and 6 evaluations per artifact; run those as separate invocations. Early stopping (80% tasks >= 0.7) is intentionally disabled in this first version (plan.md §6).
